mapper.select: SELECT sp.id AS parameterId, /* 方案分析项配置ID */ ip.code AS parameterCode, /* 分析项编码（来自lm_inspect_parameter） */ ip.name AS parameterName, /* 分析项名称（来自lm_inspect_parameter） */ t.id AS taskId, /* 复核通过任务ID */ pr.id AS parameterRecordId /* 绑定记录ID（与任务使用的record绑定） */ FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter sp ON sp.id = t.parameter_config_id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ip.id = t.parameter_id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter_record pr ON pr.parameter_id = ip.id AND pr.record_id = t.record_id WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionId} AND (t.status = 'REVIEW_PASSED' or t.status='COMPLETED' or t.status='SAMPLE_AUDIT_PENDING') AND t.execute_method = 'ELN' ORDER BY ip.code ASC

SELECT sp.id AS parameterId, ip.code AS parameterCode, ip.name AS parameterName, t.id AS taskId, pr.id AS parameterRecordId FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN lm_stability_scheme_parameter sp ON sp.id = t.parameter_config_id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON ip.id = t.parameter_id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_parameter_record pr ON pr.parameter_id = ip.id AND pr.record_id = t.record_id WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionId} AND (t.status = 'REVIEW_PASSED' or t.status='COMPLETED' or t.status='SAMPLE_AUDIT_PENDING') AND t.execute_method = 'ELN' ORDER BY ip.code ASC

SELECT bp.content FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN bm_batch_record br ON br.id = t.record_id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_item bri ON bri.item_id = t.record_item_id AND bri.record_version_id = t.record_version_id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_parse bp ON bp.id = bri.parse_id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

SELECT bp.file_content AS templateContent, bri.docx_header AS docxHeader, bri.docx_footer AS docxFooter, bri.item_id AS recordItemId, t.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, bri.page_config AS pageConfig, bri.first_different AS firstDifferent, bri.odd_and_even_different AS oddAndEvenDifferent, bri.page_number_style AS pageNumberStyle, bri.page_starting_number AS pageStartingNumber FROM lm_task t INNER JOIN bm_batch_record br ON br.id = t.record_id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_item bri ON bri.item_id = t.record_item_id AND bri.record_version_id = t.record_version_id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_parse bp ON bp.id = bri.id WHERE t.id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

SELECT bp.file_content FROM lm_inspect_parameter_record pr INNER JOIN bm_batch_record br ON br.id = pr.record_id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_item bri ON bri.record_id = br.id INNER JOIN bm_batch_record_parse bp ON bp.id = bri.id WHERE pr.id = #{parameterRecordId} LIMIT 1
SELECT d.data_json AS dataJson FROM bm_execute_form_data d WHERE d.task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bm_log_operation ( id, business_id, module, operation_type, remark, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{fields.id}, #{fields.businessId}, #{fields.module}, #{fields.operationType}, #{fields.remark}, #{fields.createBy}, NOW() )
